x: The MPPSC 2010 key treats the Mid-Day Meal as a scheme for education (enrolment, attendance), social equality (children of all castes eat together) and child nutrition, so 'right to food' is the odd one out.
dispute: MPPSC 2010 key: right to food. Strictly the scheme is linked to the right to food too — the Supreme Court's PUCL orders (2001) made cooked meals mandatory, and the NFSA 2013 (Sec. 5) makes the meal a legal entitlement.
